hero.title: About COBITUN
hero.subtitle: Tunisia's first parametric cloud outage insurance portal. Automatic payouts powered by IODA real-time monitoring — no claims forms, no adjusters, no waiting.
hero.description: Tunisia's first parametric cloud outage insurance portal. Automatic payouts powered by IODA real-time monitoring — no claims forms, no adjusters, no waiting.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.p1: At COBITUN, our mission is to protect Tunisian businesses from cloud downtime. We believe every SME deserves automatic, transparent coverage when their cloud provider fails — no paperwork, no delays, no disputes.
mission.p2: Through our innovative parametric platform, we monitor cloud providers 24/7 using Georgia Tech's IODA data. When an outage exceeds the provider's SLA MTTR threshold, claims are automatically created, approved, and paid — in minutes, not months.

values.title: Our Values
values.subtitle: The principles that drive every decision we make in building parametric insurance for Tunisian businesses.

objectiveData.title: Objective Data
objectiveData.desc: Claims triggered by IODA monitoring data from Georgia Tech, not opinions. Objective, transparent, indisputable.

tunisiaFirst.title: Tunisia-First
tunisiaFirst.desc: Built specifically for Tunisian businesses, with local providers, ANCS certification, and TND-denominated payouts.

actuarialRigor.title: Actuarial Rigor
actuarialRigor.desc: Premiums calculated from peer-reviewed actuarial models based on real outage data from 15+ Tunisian providers.

speedOfPayout.title: Speed of Payout
speedOfPayout.desc: Auto-triggered claims paid in minutes, not months. When your cloud goes down, your money arrives fast.

fullTransparency.title: Full Transparency
fullTransparency.desc: Every trigger, every calculation, every payout is visible. No hidden charges, no black-box decisions.

hybridControl.title: Hybrid Control
hybridControl.desc: Automation for speed, admin oversight for trust, policy approval for quality. Three layers protecting you.
